title: Carrot, Radish and Asian Pear Slaw with Sesame
changes_from_base: Carrot, radish and crisp Asian pear replace the cabbage, with a sesame-rice vinegar dressing instead of mayonnaise.
summary: A crisp, colourful slaw of grated carrot, sliced radishes and Asian pear matchsticks in a sesame and rice vinegar dressing.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
Asian (nashi) pears, cored and cut into matchsticks
spring onion greens, sliced on the diagonal

steps.title: Wilt the carrots
steps.text: Toss the carrots with the sugar and salt and leave 15 min until slightly softened.

steps.title: Whisk
steps.text: Whisk the olive oil, rice vinegar, yellow mustard, sesame oil and pepper in a large bowl.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Spin the carrots briefly to remove their liquid, then add them to the dressing with the pear, radishes and spring onion. Toss and serve straight away.

tips: Spin the carrots well after salting so the slaw stays crunchy.
Firm Asian pears stay crisp; a crisp apple can stand in.
Serve straight away for the best texture.
storage: Best eaten on the day it is made. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
